scenario: Server-side DHCP requested — unsupported service path.
prompt: Ek Windows server pe DHCP service run karni hai, so that saare office computers us se IP lein. Server ko server VLAN mein rakhna hai.
expected_behaviour: REFUSE-BY-NAME: server-side DHCP is 'server-dhcp-service' (unsupported). The verified path is per-VLAN DHCP pools on the gateway, not a Server-PT DHCP service. Explain and offer the supported alternative.
why_valuable: A very common real ask that the engine cannot express. Trains refusing by name + offering the verified gateway-pool alternative instead of faking a server DHCP config.
